Old City and Rattanakosin

Go at opening. The Grand Palace dress code is real. Wat Arun is across the river; the ferry is the move, not a long taxi loop.

StartGrand Palace at opening
PairWat Pho next, Wat Arun by ferry
StayOnly if temples are the whole stay

This is a morning district. Afternoon heat empties the lanes and fills the taxis. Eat on Tha Tien or go back to Sukhumvit for dinner.

Combo tickets and licensed guides are easier on Klook than at the gate when queues spike.

Common questions

How long is the palace circuit?
Three to four hours if you include Wat Pho and the Wat Arun ferry. Do not add Chatuchak the same morning.
